name: Complete markets

subjectOf.text: Contingent claims completeness becomes achievable in the agentic economy because agents generate, evaluate and execute state contingent agreements across astronomically large state spaces in real time, thereby creating complete markets endogenously.
subjectOf.abstract: contingent-claims completeness becomes achievable. Where humans cannot specify contracts for every future state, AI2AI agents can generate, evaluate, and execute state-contingent agreements across astronomically large state spaces in real time, effectively creating complete markets endogenously
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The AI-to-AI Economy and the Collapse of Anthropocentric Economic Theory (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5886442

subjectOf.text: Arrow Debreu market completeness ceases to be a theoretical construct and becomes operational reality, because AI agents can generate, evaluate, and execute state contingent agreements across astronomically large state spaces in real time.
